title: Performance Engineer - Open Source
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company.
As an open source platform, we have teams that work at every level of the software stack - from the kernel up through server and desktop applications, all the way to the web. We are adding roles with this focus in every engineering team in the company, to act as drivers of performance engineering skills, tools, culture and insights to our entire product range . We have also created a central performance engineering team, where we will drive shared tools, dashboarding capabilities, measurement frameworks, analytical capabilities and skills. We call this career focus ' percorr ' because we have found that the same deep insights that enable sophisticated performance measurement and design also enable teams to improve their harnesses and frameworks for correctness. Understanding not only the application, but the runtime, the compiler, and the system, all the way down to the CPU, gives an engineer the ability to think creatively and with insight about the right things to measure, and the right ways to verify correctness. We have found that performance engineers will often improve the deepest and trickiest areas of our test harnesses, and unblock their teams to test and measure previously 'dark' aspects of their work.
We also have teams that work with every major silicon vendor and cloud, with a particular emphasis on performance optimisation of the entire stack for that architecture, CPU family or hypervisor. Our goal is to ensure that Ubuntu users can select whatever platform they want for their workloads and know they have access to the very best performance and efficiency across the entire stack from kernel to codec.
If they wish, we will enable performance and correctness engineers to move between products every two years, so that they have the opportunity to raise the bar for performance in an array of products over time, and also that teams have the benefit of fresh eyes on their processes, thinking, harnesses, dashboards and code. Our performance and correctness leads are expected to be truly exceptional individuals, and also leaders who are confident setting expectations of change, sharing insights and skills, running initiatives and programs. There is no way to move a meaningful codebase without also moving the people behind it.
This is a career path for perfectionists and precision artists. Whether you have a particular language focus - C, C++, Rust, Golang, Python, Java, Flutter-Dart or others - or a particular love of the kernel or hardware or CPU instruction set, whether you see yourself as driving perceived user experience through performance or optimising the efficiency of data centers to reduce carbon footprint, this process is the best way to find a role at Canonical that speaks to your precision, rigour, insight and drive.
Location : We have teams in every time zone, and can accommodate applications from almost any country.
Nice-to-have skills we value

• Low-level CPU insights and assembly language - understanding cache, registers, vectorization, memory

• Kernel performance insights - scheduling, c

Our team of pentesters is seeking a pentester to join us and help secure a few hundred additional applications.

• Software development background in one or more of Python, .NET, Ruby, or Java - you understand how the thing was built, not just how to break it

Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. description:
ENGINEERING MANAGER - PLATFORM AND IT & COMPLIANCE

 
 

ABOUT TRAWA

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

 
 
 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams: Platform and IT & Compliance. Together, these teams form the foundation that everything at trawa runs on, from the cloud infrastructure powering our services to the security and compliance posture that earns the trust of our customers and partners.

You'll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, creating an environment where engineers thrive and do their best work. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will lead an established and growing group of talented engineers across two distinct but closely related domains.

At trawa, our culture is generally "office-first with flexibility", where most of us are in our beautiful Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to occasionally work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, spending minimum 3 days a week in the office.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

YOU'LL DRIVE THE EVOLUTION OF FOUR KEY AREAS:

- Scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS that powers our mission-critical services with high availability

- Great developer experience through CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence

- IT operations and security, owning the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa's systems and data safe

- End-to-end ownership of our compliance and audit processes, managing the implementation of frameworks like ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS 2, while coordinating with internal stakeholders and leading external audits

OUR TECH STACK

- AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions

- Python, TypeScript

- Dash0, Sentry, Incident.io

- Primo, Vanta

 
 
 

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 

FIRST 6 WEEKS (ONBOARDING):

- Establish strong relationships with your direct reports, peers and stakeholders

- Understand the team’s current OKRs and how they impact the organisation

- Gain a comprehensive understanding of trawa's current tech stack, infrastructure, and security posture

BY MONTH 3 (RAMP-UP):

- Define and share a clear vision and strategic roadmap for the Platform team that enhances developer experience and productivity

- Assess the current state of our IT operations and create a strategic roadmap to support trawa's growth

- Assume full ownership of our compliance programs and present a 6-12 month roadmap for maintaining and strengthening our security posture

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You have at least three years of experience in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup environment. You know how to lead across multiple teams, balance competing priorities, and create an environment where engineers do their best work

title: Technical Program Manager / RF Systems
description:
ABOUT US

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Quartermaster is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive execution across complex, multi-disciplinary RF engineering programs. In this role, you will coordinate efforts across hardware, software, manufacturing, and operations teams to ensure the ruggedized RF sensing systems that will define Quartermaster’s future capabilities are delivered on time, on spec, and ready for deployment.

You’ll serve as the connective tissue between technical contributors, strategic milestones, and customers while tracking progress, identifying risks and requirements, and enabling decision-making at all levels. You'll contribute technical judgment in engineering discussions, own relationships with contract manufacturers and key suppliers, and connect engineering with customers, growth, operations, and other engineering teams. The role has a direct line to leadership and broad ownership of how the RF capability grows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Build the strategic roadmap and execution plan for the RF sensing capability with the lead engineers, turning customer needs and leadership goals into programs, milestones, and resourcing decisions.

- Lead multiple RF product lines from prototype through production ramp and fielding, including integrated schedules, critical path, and risk across hardware, embedded systems, and software tracks.

- Manage contract manufacturers, design partners, and component suppliers: builds, quotes, first articles, test and acceptance, long-lead and single-source procurement, and scaling capacity to volume.

- Coordinate a blended team of employees and contractors, defining scope and statements of work, track deliverables, and hold partners accountable.

- Participate in technical design and test discussions with enough technical depth to spot risks, challenge assumptions, and turn trade-offs into decisions for leadership.

- Build and grow the team: define roles, write job descriptions, run hiring loops, and onboard new engineers and partners.

- Build connections with customers, growth, operations, finance, and other engineering teams, making sure commitments to customers match what engineering can deliver.

- Drive production readiness: manufacturing test, calibration and provisioning throughput, compliance and certification planning, and field support.

QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field, or equivalent hands-on RF/hardware engineering experience.

- 5+ years in technical program management, systems engineering, or hardware engineering on RF, wireless, or embedded hardware products.

- A record of delivering in ambiguous, low-requirement environments, creating the plan, structure, and ownership rather than waiting for them.

- Proven track record managing complex, multi-phase programs with hardware/software integration.

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

The Core Licensing & Devices team owns the layer that turns Verkada's licenses into revenue: a double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles every license into daily revenue recognition. This is the system Finance closes the books on and the one auditors trace, so every entry has to be right. As Verkada scales past millions of devices and the business matures toward tighter reporting and audit requirements, this system moves from important to load-bearing.

We're a small, high-trust, high-autonomy team. We give and receive feedback directly, we learn out loud, and we hold a high bar on both execution and written communication.

What You'll Do

• Own the double-entry accounting ledger that reconciles licensing into daily revenue recognition - its accounting model, its invariants, and its correctness guarantees under concurrency, retries, and failure.

• Design and lead the systems behind upmarket licensing: pay-as-you-go metering and billing, fixed-term commitments, and the packaging our enterprise customers buy.

• Build reconciliation and controls that let Finance close the books daily and let auditors trace any recognized dollar back to its source - with the auditability, immutability, and lineage a maturing company requires.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, Revenue, and Product to turn revenue-recognition policy (ASC 606, deferred revenue, contract modifications, true-ups) into precise, testable system behavior.

• Lead major features end-to-end and bring others along - through design reviews, code reviews, crisp written docs, and direct mentorship.

• Drive operational rigor: strong observability, tight SLOs, low pager noise, and blameless learning when incidents occur.

• Help shape the platform's roadmap toward the company's biggest long-term bets as Verkada scales and matures.

What You Bring

• 8+ years building backend services with strong correctness, consistency, and durability guarantees at scale.

• Depth in financial or transactional systems: ledgers, double-entry accounting, billing, payments, or revenue recognition - you understand why idempotency, exactly-once semantics, immutability, and reconciliation matter, and you've built for them.

• Comfort working shoulder-to-shoulder with Finance and Accounting - or a track record of getting deep in an unfamiliar, high-stakes domain fast.

• Fluency in Python or Go; other backend languages can contribute to your experience, but the interviews will be conducted in one of the above.

• A track record of partnering with Finance, Accounting, or other non-engineering stakeholders, translating policy and ambiguity into systems they can rely on without surprise.

title: Assigning Editor: Social & Viral News
description:
Assigning Editor: Social & Viral News

About The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.

We cover everything from major political news to the latest celebrity drama and the week’s biggest streaming hits. We also tell real stories about real people, like an everyday post on social media that hasn't yet caught anyone else's attention. This variety is the key to our success, and the right candidate should be comfortable sourcing and pitching engaging stories from all corners of the internet as well as major mainstream news.

We aim to share stories with our audience that really get them thinking, talking, and sharing them organically rather than relying on traditional SEO. We want someone who is excited about doing things a little differently and has a hunger for finding the next big story.

About The Role

As the Assigning Editor, you will be in charge of the first, and one of the most crucial, steps when it comes to formulating an engaging or thought-provoking article. You’ll lead story sourcing and pitching for our social and viral news desk across multiple brands and spend much of your day digging into the major news stories that people really care about or on TikTok (as well as Reddit and other social media platforms), spotting posts and conversations that have the makings of a big story. To excel, you’ll have a natural ability to spot the story in something that others would scroll straight past and know how to frame it so it reaches a wide audience.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume role, which will best fit someone who is comfortable pitching a large number of stories every day while using data (and natural instinct) to inform decisions over time.

What You'll Do

• Keep abreast of major world events, the latest news in the world of entertainment, and understand how to frame these topics in new and interesting ways that will resonate with our audiences

• Monitor TikTok and other social platforms every day to find stories, ideally before other publishers do

• Write clear pitches and context to give writers everything they need before starting on an article

• Assign stories to staff and freelance writers

• Frame stories and headlines for syndication and social platforms like MSN, Facebook, and SmartNews

• Track performance and use data to refine your pitches

• Build and document discovery workflows, so writers and other editors can become stronger pitchers

• Verify that stories are accurate, credit creators properly, and treat the people in our stories fairly

• Work with the wider editorial team to spot stories that deserve extra attention, follow-ups, or investigation

What We're Looking For

• Experience as an assigning, commissioning, news, trending, or social editor in a fast-moving digital media environment (or extensive experience as a self-pitching writer)

• A genuine love for the weird and wonderful worlds of TikTok and social culture, with a strong instinct for what people will want to read and a passion for exploring new niches

• Syndication and/or social media experience is a strong plus

• Excellent, compelling headline writing without being misleading

• Comfortable working with traffic data and using it to guide editorial decisions

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume pitching environment

• A strong understanding of ethical journalism

• A strong understanding of US culture and audiences

Think you can spot the next big story before anyone else? Please send us your resume, along with a cover letter that tells us who you are and what makes you a good fit for this role. We'd also love to see three social posts or stories you've come across recently that you think would make a great article, with a headline for each and a line on why you picked it.

title: Talent Acquisition Praktikum (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena (finanziert von Google Ventures) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir übernehmen deutschlandweit Hausverwaltungen und verwandeln diese in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern in Berlin zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) für unser Talent Acquisition Team, um unseren Wettbewerbsvorteil im M&A-Bereich weiter auszubauen.

Wenn wir Immobilienverwaltungsunternehmen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen, ist es entscheidend, in kurzer Zeit Mitarbeiter in unseren Unternehmen einzusetzen, die technologieaffin & lernbereit sind und den klassischen Job des Immobilienverwalters neu definieren möchten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Talente für uns zu gewinnen.

Arbeiten bei Buena bedeutet "Volle Verantwortung" ab Tag eins. Du übernimmst von Beginn an Verantwortung für ein Portfolio von über 500 Mitarbeitern und baust proaktiv “Talentpools” deutschlandweit auf. So stellst du sicher, dass jede neue Verwaltung im Portfolio zu jeder Zeit mit den besten Mitarbeitern ausgestattet ist.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserer zweiten Führungsebene im HQ, den lokalen Geschäftsführern vor Ort und unserem HQ Talent Team zusammen.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

Recruiting ist ein zentraler Teil unserer Unternehmensstrategie, daher erwarten wir eine stark technologie-unterstützte Arbeitsweise, Outputorientierung und Professionalität im Umgang mit den Talenten.

- 80% deiner ersten Monate verbringst du im Sourcing von Talenten via unserer verschiedener Kanäle. Du übernimmst auch erste Screening Gespräche.

- Du screenst den deutschen Markt systematisch und baust strategische Talentpools für zukünftige Targets auf.

- Du bringst dich mit Gestaltungsideen zu unserem Kanal-Mix zur Anziehung von Talenten in unsere TA Strategie aktiv mit ein.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Vor Ort in unserem HQ in Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg) arbeiten willst.

- Ein nachweislich ausgeprägtes Interesse an Menschen, Recruiting/Sales mitbringst, d.h. du hast beispielsweise einen erfolgreichen TikTok/IG Account, organisierst Events oä.

- Dich auf mindestens 6 Monate Praktikumszeitraum committen kannst.

- Eine hohe Resilienz in der Direktansprache besitzt, souverän agierst und ergebnisorientiert arbeitest.

- Eine sehr steile Lernkurve in den Bereichen Methodik und Technologie-unterstützten Arbeiten möchtest.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Schnelle Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

- MacBook & Studio Display.

- Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus.

- 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

- Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

- Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten 3 Jahren zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit ~25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor 3 Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor 2 Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf: Die Wohneigentumsquote in Deutschland liegt weit unter dem europäischen Durchschnitt. Buena wird das ändern.

description:

Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Role Summary

Fanatics Collectibles is looking for a QC Associate to support quality-control operations for our Autograph Operations team. This role reports into our Quality Control department and is responsible for ensuring that the autographs that make it into our product are of the highest caliber, inventoried & documented properly, and delivered on-time for production. Candidates with a passion for sports, culture, & entertainment will find themselves a strong cultural fit. 

Responsibilities:

• Conducts quality control for sticker and on-card autographs, with an emphasis on high value sets and white glove athletes

• Conducts analysis on autographs to determine "good" vs. "bad" on-card or sticker autographs

• Operate automated defect detection machine and perform due diligence and quality checks on automated QC process

• Conducts analysis on AI-based outputs to properly compile data on QC Sheets and address any discrepancies from automated QC

• Conducts product pack outs and product check-ins with vendors to ensure Autograph Operations delivers all active cards per the subject list on time

• Responsible for receipt of sticker and on-card autographs daily, to include unboxing and staging of products, data entry into Autograph Operations databases, and secure transportation of products in cages from receipt area to quality control

• Supports the secure storage and organization of high value autographs in inventory room, to include properly shelving on-card autographs in alphabetically order by product

• Mentors and trains less experienced QC Associates; provide guidance and training as questions or discrepancies arise

The Ideal Candidate: 

•  High school diploma or GED required

•  1-2 years of experience in manufacturing or production environments, preferred

•  Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

•  Ability to lift 10-15 lbs. at once, preferred

•  Proficient experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel), required

•  Prior experience with data management systems, a plus

title: Security Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System , das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.
Hilf dabei, Shopware-Produkte sicherer zu machen, indem du während der gesamten Produktentwicklung Sicherheitsrisiken aufdeckst und reduzierst. Product Security Engineering ist eine Engineering-Funktion . Die Produktteams bleiben dafür verantwortlich, ihren eigenen Code zu korrigieren und zu testen. • Untersuche Schwachstellenmeldungen, Sicherheitswarnungen, interne Findings und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen . Bewerte die technischen Auswirkungen und unterstütze dabei, bestätigte Aufgaben an die zuständigen Product Owner weiterzuleiten.

• Arbeite direkt mit Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern an sicherem Design, Threat Models, Code Reviews, Ursachenanalysen, Fixes und Regressionstests für besonders risikoreiche Produktbereiche.

• Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen , Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

• Unterstütze dabei, für Product-Security-Findings klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Schweregrade, Reaktionsziele, betroffene Versionen und Nachweise zum Abschluss festzuhalten.

• Arbeite mit den Engineering-Teams von Commerce Core und Services an Sicherheitsaufgaben über verschiedene Repositories, unterstützte Versionen, APIs, Integrationen und das Extension-Ökosystem hinweg .

• Unterstütze koordinierte Sicherheits-Releases : Ermittle betroffene Bereiche, prüfe technische Behebungen und stimme dich mit Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel ab.

• Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases in konkrete Änderungen am Engineering, Tests oder Tools. Verfolge anschließend nach, ob diese Maßnahmen übernommen werden.

• Kommuniziere bei zeitkritischen Aufgaben klar und dokumentiere Entscheidungen in den vereinbarten GitHub- und Confluence-Einträgen, damit Teams den Status nicht aus Slack-Verläufen rekonstruieren müssen.

• Wirke an gemeinsamen Teampraktiken mit und vertrete bei Bedarf den anderen Produktbereich.

Das bringst du mit:

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Interesse an Produkt- oder Anwendungssicherheit.

• Praktische Kenntnisse typischer Risiken in der Anwendungssicherheit , etwa Schwachstellen bei Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, Injection und Abhängigkeiten.

• Die Fähigkeit, produktiven Code und Tests zu lesen und zu ändern , Risiken für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler verständlich zu erklären und wartbare Fixes mit umzusetzen.

• Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling, Sicherheitstests, Schwachstellenanalysen oder Secure Code Reviews ; in einigen Bereichen bringst du fundiertes Wissen mit, in anderen möchtest du dich weiterentwickeln.

• Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Schweregrad, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden und Ausnutzbarkeit sowie bei der Frage, wann ein Problem sofort eskaliert werden muss.

• Kenntnisse von PHP sowie mit Shopwares Produkten, Services oder dem Extension-Ökosystem sind hilfreich.

AST is in search of an Environmental Test Technician I supports execution of environmental qualification and environmental test activities including thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, acoustic, and related testing. title: Senior Director, Care Operational Excellence
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)
Toast is looking for a Senior Director, Customer Care Operational Excellence to own how our customer support organization operates, end to end. This is a build-and-run role: you will design (and continuously redesign) the people, process, systems, and data that determine whether every customer, from our smallest SMB accounts to our largest Enterprise relationships, gets a fast, effortless, high-quality resolution.
This role sits at the center of our AI transformation of Support operations, evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI across chat, voice, and agent-assist workflows, while also owning the fundamentals: workforce planning and capacity, quality and performance measurement, and a closed-loop voice-of-customer program that feeds directly into our product and engineering roadmaps. You will lead a team, and this is a hands-on role: you're expected to get into the details, run point on hard problems personally, and build things yourself when needed.
Support Operating Model: People, Process & Systems

• Own the end-to-end design of how Support operates: org structure, staffing model, tiering/routing, escalation paths, and channel model (chat, email, phone, self-service, community), and continuously refine it as the business scales.

• Build and run the operating cadence for the function: performance reviews, root-cause/escalation reviews, leadership readouts, and continuous-improvement rhythms.

• Segment design so that SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customers each get a service model appropriate to their needs, complexity, and value.

• AI & Support Technology Transformation

• Own the roadmap for AI-enabled support, including virtual agents/chatbots, voice AI, agent-assist, and automation, from business case through implementation, measured adoption, and iteration.

• Partner with Product and Engineering as a co-owner of the tools and systems Support runs on: helpdesk/CRM, contact center (CCaaS), knowledge base, and AI/automation platforms, representing Support's requirements and stress-testing what's shipped.

• Evaluate, select, and manage the vendor and technology stack (including AI vendors and BPO/outsourcing partners), balancing cost, quality, and customer experience.

Data, Insights & Performance Measurement

• Define the metrics that matter for Toast ’s support operations, including but not limited to TTR/resolution time, CSAT, customer effort (CES), quality/QA scores, cost-to-serve, and AI containment/deflection rate. Partner with Analytics to build the reporting and analytics and associated insights to drive operations across lines of business, segments, channels, and geographies.

• Build a rigorous quality assurance program (QA scoring, calibration, coaching feedback loops) to ensure consistency as the org scales and as AI takes on more of the work.

• Use data to diagnose root causes of poor experience and prioritize the highest-leverage fixes across people, process, and systems.

• Voice of the Customer & Product Feedback

• Own Product Feedback program in partnership with VOC and other related efforts: capturing, synthesizing, and prioritizing feedback and issues surfaced through Support.

• Build the formal, closed-loop mechanism that routes customer and product feedback to R&D/Product leadership, ensuring it gets actioned and tracked through to impact on support volume and CSAT.

• Workforce Planning & Capacity Management

• Own workforce planning, forecasting, and capacity management (staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, real-time management) across in-house and outsourced/BPO teams.

• Model the impact of AI automation on headcount and capacity plans, and adjust staffing levels as containment rates change.
